title.zh: 公司（控制人、名义董事、名义股东及外国公司成员登记册）条例 2017
title.en: Companies (Registers of Controllers, Nominee Directors, Nominee Shareholders, and Members of Foreign Companies) Regulations 2017

completenessNote: 全文，共 28 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 9 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en:
1. These Regulations are the Companies (Registers of Controllers, Nominee Directors, Nominee Shareholders, and Members of Foreign Companies) Regulations 2017 and come into operation on 31 March 2017.
[S 350/2025 wef 16/06/2025]

2. In these Regulations, “identity card” has the meaning given to it in section 2(1) of the National Registration Act 1965.
[S 786/2022 wef 31/12/2021]

heading.en: Prescribed manner of confirmation under section 386AF(10) of Act, etc.

text.en:
5.—(1) For the purposes of section 386AF(10) of the Act, the particulars of a controller to be entered in a company’s or foreign company’s register of controllers are treated as confirmed if —
(a)in response to a notice of the company or foreign company given under section 386AG(2) of the Act, a person confirms, or a registered corporate service provider confirms on behalf of the person, that the person is a registrable controller and has provided those particulars; or
[S 298/2025 wef 09/06/2025]
(b)a person has notified the company or foreign company under section 386AJ(1) of the Act that the person is a registrable controller and has provided those particulars.
(2) For the purposes of section 386AF(10) of the Act, the particulars of a controller to be updated in a company’s or foreign company’s register of controllers (called in this paragraph the new particulars) are treated as confirmed if —
(a)in response to a notice of the company or foreign company given under section 386AH(1) or 386AIA(1) of the Act, the registrable controller confirms, or a registered corporate service provider confirms on behalf of the registrable controller, that a change in the registrable controller’s particulars that are stated in the register of controllers has occurred and has provided the new particulars as the particulars that have changed;
[S 298/2025 wef 09/06/2025]
[S 350/2025 wef 16/06/2025]
(b)in response to a notice of the company or foreign company given under section 386AI(1) or 386AIA(1) of the Act, the registrable controller confirms, or a registered corporate service provider confirms on behalf of the registrable controller, that the particulars that are stated in the register of controllers are incorrect and has provided the new particulars as the correct particulars; or
[S 298/2025 wef 09/06/2025]
[S 350/2025 wef 16/06/2025]
(c)the registrable controller has notified the company or foreign company under section 386AK(1) of the Act that a change in the registrable controller’s particulars that are stated in the register of controllers has occurred and has provided the new particulars as the particulars that have changed.
(3) The particulars or new particulars provided under paragraph (1) or (2) (as the case may be) must be accompanied by —
(a)a statement made by the registrable controller that the information provided in the registrable controller’s confirmation or notification is true and accurate; and
(b)the registrable controller’s signature, and the date of the signature, affixed immediately below the statement.
[S 350/2025 wef 16/06/2025]

heading.en: Prescribed form and place of register of nominee directors under section 386AKA(1) of Act

text.en:
9. For the purposes of section 386AKA(1) of the Act —
(a)the prescribed form of the register of nominee directors is set out in the Seventh Schedule; and
(b)any of the following places is a prescribed place:
(i)the registered office of the company or foreign company;
[S 350/2025 wef 16/06/2025]
(ii)the registered office of any registered corporate service provider appointed by the company or foreign company for the purpose of providing a registered office, business address, correspondence or administrative address or other related services for the company or foreign company.

Prescribed form and manner of lodgment

text.en:
10C. For the purposes of section 386AN(3) of the Act, any lodgment made under section 386AN(2)(b) of the Act must be made through the electronic transaction system established under Part 6A of the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority Act 2004.
[S 786/2022 wef 04/10/2022]

heading.en: Prescribed circumstances for disclosure, etc., of central register of controllers

text.en:
10D.—(1) For the purposes of section 386AN(6) of the Act, the Registrar may disclose any information in the central register of controllers of companies and foreign companies kept by the Registrar to —
(a)a public agency, where —
(i)the public agency has requested information in the central register of controllers of companies and foreign companies; and
(ii)the information so requested is for the purpose of enabling the public agency to administer or enforce any written law or conduct public procurement; or
(b)a financial institution, for the purpose of enabling the financial institution —
(i)to conduct customer due diligence measures to prevent money laundering and terrorism financing; or
(ii)to otherwise comply with any directions issued under section 16 of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2022, or any regulations made under section 192 of that Act, for the prevention of money laundering and terrorism financing.
(2) In this regulation —
“financial institution” has the meaning given by section 2 of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2022;
“public agency” has the meaning given by section 386AM(6) of the Act.
[S 350/2025 wef 16/06/2025]

chapter.en: PART 3C REGISTERS OF NOMINEE DIRECTORS AND NOMINEE SHAREHOLDERS

heading.en: Prescribed form and manner of lodgment

text.en:
10E. For the purposes of section 386ANA(3) of the Act, any lodgment under section 386ANA(2) of the Act must be made using the electronic transaction system established under Part 6A of the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority Act 2004.
[S 350/2025 wef 16/06/2025]

chapter.en: PART 3C REGISTERS OF NOMINEE DIRECTORS AND NOMINEE SHAREHOLDERS

heading.en: Prescribed circumstances for disclosure, etc., of central registers of nominee directors and nominee shareholders

text.en:
10F.—(1) For the purposes of section 386ANA(6) of the Act, the Registrar may disclose any information in the central register of nominee directors or the central register of nominee shareholders kept by the Registrar to a public agency, where —
(a)the public agency has requested information in the central register of nominee directors or the central register of nominee shareholders; and
(b)the information so requested has been requested for the purpose of enabling the public agency to administer or enforce any written law.
(2) For the purpose of section 386ANA(6) of the Act, the Registrar may disclose information regarding any nominee director or nominee shareholder of a company or foreign company as reflected in the central register of nominee directors or the central register of nominee shareholders, to any member of the public —
(a)as part of a service provided to the public by the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority by which information relating to transactions with the Registrar is supplied to the public, using the electronic transaction system;
(b)as part of the implementation of Part 6A of the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority Act 2004, using the electronic transaction system; or
(c)for any other reason.
(3) In this regulation —
“electronic transaction system” means the electronic transaction system established by the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority under section 27(1) of the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority Act 2004;
“public agency” has the meaning given by section 386AM(6) of the Act.
[S 350/2025 wef 16/06/2025]

chapter.en: PART 4 REGISTER OF MEMBERS OF FOREIGN COMPANY

text.en:
11.—(1) For the purposes of section 384(a)(ii) of the Act, section 192(2) and (3) of the Act applies to the register of members of a foreign company as it applies to the register of members of a public company, subject to the modifications in paragraph (2).
(2) For the purposes of paragraph (1) —
(a)a reference in section 192(2) and (3) of the Act to “any member” is to be read as a reference to “any member of the foreign company”;
(b)a reference in section 192(3) of the Act to “the public company” is to be read as a reference to “the foreign company”; and
(c)a reference in section 192(3) of the Act to “the company” is to be read as a reference to “the foreign company”.
(3) Subject to the modification in paragraph (4), section 192(4) of the Act applies to a failure to send a copy of the register of members of a foreign company requested under section 192(3) of the Act as applied by paragraph (1).
(4) The modification mentioned in paragraph (3) is that —
(a)the reference in section 192(4) of the Act to “subsection (3)” is to be read as a reference to “section 192(3) of the Act, as applied by regulation 11(1) of the Companies (Registers of Controllers, Nominee Directors, Nominee Shareholders and Members of Foreign Companies) Regulations 2017”; and
[S 350/2025 wef 16/06/2025]
(b)each reference to “the company” is to be read as a reference to “the foreign company”.

Regulation 4
First column
Second column
Provision of Act (description)
Prescribed frequency, time or period
1.Section 386AF(8) and (9)(a) (prescribed time to enter particulars of any controller in register or update particulars of any controller in register)
7 calendar days after each date on which the particulars of any controller are confirmed by the controller
2.Section 386AF(8) and (9)(b) (prescribed time to enter or update particulars with a note indicating that the particulars have not been confirmed by the controller, if the company or foreign company does not receive the controller’s confirmation)
7 calendar days after the end of 30 days after the date on which a notice mentioned in section 386AG(2), 386AH(1) or 386AI(1) (as the case may be) of the Act is sent by the company or foreign company
2A.Section 386AFA(4) (prescribed period within which matters mentioned in section 386AFA(3) must be entered in register of controllers)
2 business days after the date mentioned in section 386AFA(4)(a) or (b), as the case may be
2B.Section 386AFA(5) (prescribed period within which register of controllers must be updated to reflect change in particulars entered under section 386AFA(3)(b))
2 business days after the date on which the company or foreign company knows, or has reasonable grounds to believe, that any change in the particulars entered in its register of controllers under section 386AFA(3)(b) has occurred
3.Section 386AG(3)(a) (prescribed time for compliance with a notice mentioned in section 386AG(2))
30 days after the date on which the notice mentioned in section 386AG(2) of the Act is sent by the company or foreign company
4.Section 386AG(3)(c) (prescribed period within which a notice mentioned in section 386AG(2) must be given)
2 business days after the date on which the company or foreign company first knows the existence of, or first has reasonable grounds to believe that there exists, a person to whom a notice must be given under section 386AG(2) of the Act
5.Section 386AH(2) (prescribed period within which a notice mentioned in section 386AH(1) must be given)
2 business days after the date on which the company or foreign company first knows of a relevant change in the particulars of a registrable controller that are stated in the company’s or foreign company’s register of controllers, or first has reasonable grounds to believe that such a change has occurred
6.Section 386AG(3)(a) as applied by section 386AH(3) (prescribed time for compliance with a notice mentioned in section 386AH(1))
30 days after the date on which the notice mentioned in section 386AH(1) of the Act is sent by the company or foreign company
7.Section 386AI(2) (prescribed period within which notice mentioned in section 386AI(1) must be given)
2 business days after the date on which the company or foreign company first knows or first has reasonable grounds to believe that any of the particulars of a registrable controller that are stated in the company’s or foreign company’s register of controllers is incorrect
8.Section 386AG(3)(a) as applied by section 386AI(3) (prescribed time for compliance with a notice mentioned in section 386AI(1))
30 days after the date on which the notice mentioned in section 386AI(1) of the Act is sent by the company or foreign company
9.Section 386AJ(2) (prescribed time for compliance with the requirements of section 386AJ(1))
30 days after the date on which the person first knew or ought reasonably to have known that that person was a registrable controller
10.Section 386AK(2) (prescribed time for compliance with the requirements of section 386AK(1))
30 days after the date on which the person first knew or ought reasonably to have known that a relevant change has occurred in the prescribed particulars of that person
11.Section 386AN(3) (prescribed time within which the particulars mentioned in section 386AN(2)(b)(i) must be lodged with the Registrar)
For a company or foreign company incorporated or registered before 16 June 2025 — 2 business days after the date on which the company or foreign company enters the particulars of its registrable controllers in the register
For a company incorporated on or after 16 June 2025 — at the time of incorporation
For a foreign company registered on or after 16 June 2025 — at the time of registration
12.Section 386AN(3) (prescribed time within which the updates mentioned in section 386AN(2)(b)(ii) must be lodged with the Registrar)
Where the company or foreign company enters or updates the particulars of any registrable controller in its register under section 386AF(9) of the Act — 2 business days after the date on which the company or foreign company enters or updates the particulars of the registrable controller
13.Section 386AIA(1) (prescribed frequency for which a notice mentioned in section 386AIA(1) must be given)
At least one notice mentioned in section 386AIA(1) of the Act must be given every calendar year to each registrable controller whose particulars are stated in the company’s or foreign company’s register of controllers
14.Section 386AIA(2)(a) (prescribed time for compliance with a notice mentioned in section 386AIA(1))
30 days after the date on which the notice mentioned in section 386AIA(1) of the Act is sent by the company or foreign company
15.Section 386ANA(2)(a) and (3) (prescribed time within which the particulars mentioned in section 386ANA(2)(a) must be lodged with the Registrar)
For a company or foreign company incorporated or registered before 16 June 2025 — by 31 December 2025
For a company incorporated on or after 16 June 2025 — at the time of incorporation
For a foreign company registered on or after 16 June 2025 — at the time of registration
16.Section 386ANA(2)(b) and (3) (prescribed time within which the updates mentioned in section 386ANA(2)(b) must be lodged with the Registrar)
2 business days after the date on which the company or foreign company updates its register of nominee directors under section 386AKA of the Act
17.Section 386ANA(2)(c) and (3) (prescribed time within which the particulars mentioned in section 386ANA(2)(c) must be lodged with the Registrar)
For a company or foreign company incorporated or registered before 16 June 2025 — by 31 December 2025
For a company incorporated on or after 16 June 2025 — at the time of incorporation
For a foreign company registered on or after 16 June 2025 — at the time of registration
18.Section 386ANA(2)(d) and (3) (prescribed time within which the updates mentioned in section 386ANA(2)(d) must be lodged with the Registrar)
2 business days after the date on which the company or foreign company updates the particulars in its register of nominee shareholders under section 386ALA of the Act
